source.original_question:
The meteoroid projected in the direction of B is moving.


What distance will the meteoroid travelling towards point B have covered after 29 minutes?

adaptations.reason: Decorative scenery/icons removed; native mathematical lines, angle arcs, measurements and point relationships retained.

independent_solution.method: Use the branch directed towardsB: distance=speed*time=7860*(29/60)=3799km.
